column4: Description
The system must allow clients and providers to register by entering their basic information and access credentials.
The system must validate user credentials and generate a JWT token to manage secure sessions.
The system must restrict views and actions according to the assigned role (Administrator, Client, Provider, Security Guard).
The system must allow users to recover access through a temporary token sent to their registered email.
The system must allow the Administrator to register halls, defining name, location, maximum capacity, and hourly cost.
The system must allow checking a hall's availability on any date of the year
The system must record bookings by time range
column5: preventing overlap or duplicate schedules for the same hall.

column4: The system must allow uploading and storing photographs of the halls.
The system must allow the Administrator to disable halls or specific time ranges on given days for maintenance or private events.
The system must allow the Client to view and update their personal data, contact information, and notification methods.
The system must show the Client a detailed list of their past, active, and cancelled events with their respective invoices or summaries.
The system must provide the Client with a panel to manage the guest list and the hired provider services for an active event.
The system must allow Providers to register and update their services (catering, entertainment, music, decoration) with descriptions and prices.
The system must allow attaching one or more provider services to an event hall booking.
The system must offer Providers a calendar to view the dates, times, and halls where they must deliver their services.
The system must allow the Client to rate and leave a review of the services provided by the Provider once the event has concluded.
The system must calculate the total amount by adding the hourly hall cost and the accumulated cost of the selected provider services.
The system must generate and store the purchase order in pending or paid status
column5: associating it with the client and the event.

column4: The system must allow the Administrator or the payment gateway to update the payment status (Pending, Completed, Refunded).
The system must generate a detailed summary of the purchase in digital format for the client to view or download.
The system must allow the Client to enter guests individually or perform a bulk upload with contact details.
The system must generate a unique hash and represent it graphically as an exclusive QR code for each guest and registered event.
The system must allow the Security Guard to validate the authenticity of the QR code presented by the guest through the web application.
The system must mark the QR code as "Used" after the first successful scan to prevent the same entry from being reused.
The system must allow the Client to individually resend the QR-coded ticket if a guest loses it.
The system must send an automatic email to the Client confirming the hall booking and the hired services.
The system must automatically send invitations with the packaged QR code to the email address of each registered guest.
The system must notify Clients, Providers, and Guests by email of any change in date or cancellation of the event.
The system must notify the Administrator when a new Provider requests registration or when a failure occurs in external integrations.
The NestJS monolithic backend must operate behind a Proxy server (Nginx) without publicly exposing its private IP or ports.
The database must be hosted on a physically independent server with no public access, accepting connections only from the backend's IP.
Requests processed by the NestJS routes must respond with an average time under 300 ms under normal traffic conditions.
The Angular web application must adapt its layout to desktop browsers and mobile devices to facilitate QR reading at the door.
The system must maintain 99.5% operational availability throughout the year to guarantee real-time queries and validations.
The QR validation module must be compatible with the cameras of mobile devices running modern browsers (Chrome, Safari).
